name: ModelUsage
summary: Consumption split by model: which one took how much.

a11y.apg: meter — each bar is a share of a known total, not a task advancing. The bar width is not readable on its own, so aria-valuetext carries the formatted number.

props.name: entries
props.description: One row per model: model, optional provider, and the three measures (tokens, cost, requests). Rows are sorted descending by the active metric, on a copy — the caller's array is not mutated.

props.name: metric
props.description: Which measure the bars compare. The reference exposes the same choice as four tabs because each one is a separate query in its product; here the data arrives ready and the dimension is a prop.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code, used only when metric is "cost".

props.name: locale
props.description: Passed to Intl.NumberFormat. The default is fixed on purpose: a locale read from the environment would make the rendered text differ between a developer machine and CI, and the catalogue is rendered ahead of time.
